recommendation: Monitor treatment adherence and response for anxiety disorders
implementation_steps: Monitor treatment adherence and response using standardized tools
Provide patient education about anxiety symptoms and management
Coordinate care across primary care and mental health providers
Support implementation of stepped care approaches based on symptom severity
Facilitate regular follow-up to assess treatment effectiveness
evidence_summary: Nurse care manager-led monitoring interventions have demonstrated improvements in anxiety symptom management, treatment adherence, and outcomes when implemented within collaborative care models.
